FN-DIRBTHH-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 374
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Ritchie Whorton
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/02/2024
House Bill 374 as introduced would increase the annual additional fee for the volunteer and
professional firefighter and retired firefighter distinctive vehicle license plates from $1 to $10.
This bill would also revise the distribution of these funds as provided below, which would
increase estimated receipts to the entities listed :
